subject: Virtual loop contingency: compressing + backup sequence for Jordan Park
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Virtual onsite for Jordan Park — proposed schedule + attachments

Hi team,

We're moving Jordan Park (applied SRE) into a virtual onsite. Candidate is in PST and asked for a single-day preference but can do two half-days if needed. Attached: Jordan_Park_Resume.pdf and proposed_loop_v2.pdf (two variants: 1-day compact and 2-day expanded).

Ask: please skim the proposed 1-day and confirm whether you can commit to the interviewer slots or whether we should fall back to the 2-day. I need firm availability to lock calendar invites and send candidate a confirmation by EOD tomorrow.

High-level proposed (1-day):
- 9:30–10:00 AM PT: Intro / PM sync (Laura)
- 10:15–11:00 AM PT: Systems design (Markus)
- 11:15–12:00 PM PT: Debugging exercise (Avery)
- 12:00–12:30 PM PT: Lunch break (candidate)
- 12:45–1:30 PM PT: Deep dive / culture fit (Laura + cross-functional)
- 1:45–2:30 PM PT: Exec Q&A (optional)

Notes:
- Proposed buffer: 15 minutes between sessions to give Jordan a break and to handle overruns.
- If we can't get Markus for the morning, the 1-day compress option becomes risky; consider the 2-day split.

Attachments are lightweight stubs here: Jordan_Park_Resume.pdf (resume, 2 pages), proposed_loop_v2.pdf (detailed agenda).

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Recruiter, Talent
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite for Jordan Park — proposed schedule + attachments

Thanks Marissa — quick note from me: I'd prefer a single-day loop if we can keep it tight. Two asks:

1) Please prioritize Markus for the core systems design slot (it's the strongest signal for the role).
2) Candidate is PST; we should avoid late afternoon slots that push into their evening.

If Markus can't do the morning, I'm OK with flipping the design piece to right after lunch, but then we should sequence the interviewers so the highest-signal interviews occur earlier.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Hiring Manager, SRE
Redwood Inference

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite for Jordan Park — proposed schedule + attachments

Marissa — thanks for the options. I'm including a quick contingency sequence that preserves the most important signals even if we have a mid-day interviewer conflict. I attached slot_grid_v3.xlsx with availability flags; short summary below.

Candidate timezone: PST (confirmed). Our team PV: Pacific-friendly windows 9:30–14:30.

Contingency (1-day preferred, but re-ordered):
- 9:30–10:00 PT: Intro + role expectations (Laura)
- 10:05–10:50 PT: Troubleshooting/Debugging (backup: Markus OR Systems panel) — moves earlier to ensure core tech coverage
- 11:05–11:50 PT: Systems Design (Markus — prefer afternoon if morning conflict; see fallback)
- 12:00–12:30 PT: Buffer / lunch
- 12:45–1:30 PT: Cross-functional + culture (Laura + rotating interviewer)
- 1:40–2:20 PT: Hiring manager debrief + Qs (Laura)

If Markus is unavailable from 10–11, plan: swap the design with the debugging slot and have Markus cover design at 11:05; if Markus is unavailable for the whole morning, we trigger the 2-day plan from proposed_loop_v2.pdf where design is on Day 2.

Please note: to keep things smooth, we'll hold a 10-minute pre-brief 15 minutes before the loop for interviewers who can join (Google Meet link in final invite).

A couple of operational asks for Calendar invites:
- Put the candidate email in To, include "No recordings" note in the description, and add the attachments as links (resume + loop agenda).
- Add a 5-minute buffer slot after each interview in the calendar to avoid overlap.

I'm available to move my slot if needed; Markus, can you confirm morning vs afternoon?

— Avery
Senior Staff SRE, Interviewer
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite for Jordan Park — proposed schedule + attachments

Avery / Marissa — I can do the loop but not the 10:15–11:00 slot (conflict with infra review). I can take 11:05–11:50 and 1:40–2:20 if you flip the design slot later.

So: happy to cover Systems Design at 11:05 and Exec/Manager Q at 1:40. If you prefer me earlier, I can swap the infra review but would prefer to avoid that.

— Markus
Principal Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Park <jordan.park@gmail.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Greenfield Labs Talent <talent@greenfield.io>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Jordan Park virtual onsite (May 25) — updated sequence and calendar invites

Hi Jordan — thanks again for the flexibility. We finalized a single-day virtual onsite for Tuesday, May 25. Below is the confirmed sequence (all PT):

- 9:30–10:00 AM: Intro + role expectations — Laura Bennett (Google Meet link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=0a1b2c3d4e5f)
- 10:05–10:50 AM: Troubleshooting exercise — Avery Johnson
- 11:05–11:50 AM: Systems design — Markus Klein
- 12:00–12:30 PM: Lunch (candidate break)
- 12:45–1:30 PM: Cross-functional & culture — Laura Bennett + rotating interviewer
- 1:40–2:20 PM: Hiring manager debrief + Qs — Laura Bennett

Attachments: Jordan_Park_Resume.pdf, proposed_loop_v2.pdf. I've also shared the interviewer availability grid with the team (slot_grid_v3.xlsx).

Logistics / notes for candidate:
- Please join each Meet from the calendar invites; there will be a 5-minute buffer between sessions.
- We do not record interviews.
- If anything changes, reply to this thread and we'll confirm updates within one business day.

Marissa will send individual calendar invites and the pre-brief link to interviewers 1 business day before the loop.

Thanks all — looking forward.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Recruiter, Talent
Redwood Inference
